cues.setup: Hold one dumbbell at the chest, elbows tucked.
cues.exec: Sit between the hips, elbows inside the knees, full depth.
cues.fix: Heels lifting? Widen the stance and slow the descent.

edges.note: Box begrenzt Tiefe und gibt Zielhoehe

cues.setup: Box behind you at knee height, feet shoulder-width.
cues.exec: Sit back until you touch, stand up without rocking.
cues.fix: Plopping down? Control the last third of the descent.

cues.setup: Bar on the upper back, feet slightly in front of the bar path.
cues.exec: Unhook, sit straight down along the rail, drive back up.
cues.fix: Knees caving? Screw the feet into the floor and push them out.

cues.setup: Back flat on the pad, feet mid-platform, shoulders under the pads.
cues.exec: Lower deep with knees tracking the toes, press without locking hard.
cues.fix: Hips lifting off the pad? Raise the foot position slightly.

cues.setup: Bar on the back, box at parallel height behind you.
cues.exec: Sit back to a soft touch, stay tight, drive up through the heels.
cues.fix: Rocking off the box? Pause dead still, then stand in one piece.

cues.setup: One dumbbell on each shoulder, elbows high, torso tall.
cues.exec: Squat to full depth keeping the chest up and elbows lifted.
cues.fix: Falling forward? Lighter dumbbells, drive the elbows up.

cues.setup: Bar in the rack at knee height, hands just outside the legs.
cues.exec: Hinge, brace, drive the hips through to a tall lockout.
cues.fix: Yanking with the arms? Push the floor away, arms stay ropes.

cues.setup: Stand centered in the bar, neutral grip on the handles.
cues.exec: Push the floor away, hips and chest rise together, stand tall.
cues.fix: Back rounding? Drop the hips and re-set the lats first.

edges.note: neutrale Griffe, Last in der Koerperachse

cues.setup: Wide stance, toes out, shins vertical, hands inside the knees.
cues.exec: Wedge the hips down, spread the floor, drive to lockout.
cues.fix: Knees caving? Push them out over the toes off the floor.

cues.setup: Face away, rope between the legs, step out until taut.
cues.exec: Hinge back letting the rope pull, snap the hips to stand tall.
cues.fix: Squatting it? Soft knees only, hips travel back not down.

cues.setup: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, soft knees, chest proud.
cues.exec: Hinge until the hamstrings load, then stand by squeezing glutes.
cues.fix: Back rounding at depth? Shorten the range, re-set the brace.

cues.setup: Dumbbell opposite the standing leg, soft knee, square hips.
cues.exec: Hinge as the rear leg lifts, torso and leg move as one lever.
cues.fix: Hips opening? Point the rear toes down and slow the rep.

cues.setup: Light bar on the back, feet hip-width, soft knees.
cues.exec: Hinge until the torso nears parallel, stand with tight glutes.
cues.fix: Losing the arch? Reduce depth, brace before every rep.

edges.note: Stange auf dem Ruecken statt in den Haenden

cues.setup: On the floor, padded bar over the hips, heels close.
cues.exec: Drive the hips up to a straight line, squeeze one second.
cues.fix: Arching the back? Tuck the ribs, finish with the glutes.

cues.setup: Lie down, knees bent, heels under the knees, arms flat.
cues.exec: Push through the heels, lift the hips, squeeze at the top.
cues.fix: Hamstrings cramping? Move the heels an inch closer.

cues.setup: Upper back on the bench, padded smith bar over the hips.
cues.exec: Unhook, drive hips to full extension, chin tucked.
cues.fix: Overarching at the top? Stop at a straight hip line.

cues.setup: Dumbbells at the sides, tall posture, eyes forward.
cues.exec: Step long, rear knee kisses the floor, drive through the front heel.
cues.fix: Wobbling sideways? Shorten the step and slow the tempo.

cues.setup: Staggered stance, dumbbells at the sides, hips square.
cues.exec: Lower straight down until the rear knee hovers, drive up.
cues.fix: Front heel lifting? Lengthen the stance one shoe.

cues.setup: Staggered stance, hands on hips or out for balance.
cues.exec: Drop the rear knee toward the floor, torso tall, push back up.
cues.fix: Knee diving inward? Track it over the middle toes.

cues.setup: Dumbbells at the sides, feet hip-width, chest tall.
cues.exec: Step back, lower the rear knee, push through the front foot.
cues.fix: Knee pain stepping forward? This version keeps the shin vertical.

cues.setup: Box at knee height, whole foot on top, dumbbells at the sides.
cues.exec: Drive through the top heel to stand, lower with control.
cues.fix: Pushing off the floor leg? Keep its toes light, top leg works.

edges.note: statisches Muster ohne Last und Box

cues.setup: Rear foot on the bench, bar on the back, front foot forward.
cues.exec: Lower along the rail to 90 degrees, drive up evenly.
cues.fix: Sliding forward? Re-set the front foot further out.

cues.setup: One foot mid-platform, hips square against the pad.
cues.exec: Lower deep, knee tracks the toes, press without locking out.
cues.fix: Hip twisting? Reduce the weight and slow the negative.

cues.setup: Thigh pad locked down, knee joint aligned with the pivot.
cues.exec: Curl the pad under the seat, pause, return slowly.
cues.fix: Hips lifting? Pull the lap pad tighter before the set.

cues.setup: On your back, heels on sliders or a towel, hips bridged.
cues.exec: Slide the heels out long, pull them back keeping hips high.
cues.fix: Hips dropping? Shorten the slide until you own the bridge.

cues.setup: Lie prone, band anchored low behind you, loop around the ankles.
cues.exec: Curl the heels to the glutes, resist the band on the way back.
cues.fix: Hips popping up? Squeeze the glutes and press them down.

cues.setup: One shin behind the pad, knee aligned with the machine pivot.
cues.exec: Extend to a full squeeze, lower over two seconds.
cues.fix: Strong leg taking over across sets? Start with the weaker leg.

cues.setup: Seated, band anchored behind, loop around one ankle.
cues.exec: Straighten the knee against the band, pause, return slow.
cues.fix: Band slipping? Anchor lower and shorten the loop.

cues.setup: Balls of the feet on the ledge, pads snug on the knees.
cues.exec: Deep stretch at the bottom, pause, press to full tiptoe.
cues.fix: Bouncing? Two-second pause in the stretch kills momentum.

cues.setup: One foot on a step edge, fingertips on the wall for balance.
cues.exec: Lower to a full stretch, rise all the way onto the big toe.
cues.fix: Rolling to the outside? Finish over the big toe every rep.

cues.setup: Bar on the upper back, balls of the feet on a plate or block.
cues.exec: Full stretch down, powerful rise, one-second squeeze on top.
cues.fix: Knees bending? Keep them long so the calves do the work.

cues.setup: Sit tall, knees against the pads, feet on the rests.
cues.exec: Press the knees apart, hold the widest point briefly.
cues.fix: Leaning back to cheat? Chest stays over the hips.

cues.setup: Mini band above the knees, quarter-squat stance.
cues.exec: Step sideways keeping tension, feet never touch together.
cues.fix: Standing tall between steps? Stay low the whole set.

cues.setup: Dumbbells over the chest, feet planted, blades pinned.
cues.exec: Lower to the outer chest, press up and slightly together.
cues.fix: Wrists wobbling at the bottom? Reduce the load one step.

cues.setup: Seat so the handles sit at mid-chest, blades back.
cues.exec: Press to a soft lockout, return until the chest stretches.
cues.fix: Shoulders rolling forward? Pin the blades before each press.

cues.setup: Bench under the rail so the bar meets mid-chest.
cues.exec: Unhook, lower to a light touch, press along the rail.
cues.fix: Bar path feels off? Shift the bench, not your arch.

cues.setup: On the floor, knees bent, dumbbells over the chest.
cues.exec: Lower until the upper arms rest, pause, press back up.
cues.fix: Bouncing the elbows? Dead-stop each rep on the floor.

cues.setup: Band under the upper back, one end in each hand, knees bent.
cues.exec: Press to lockout against rising band tension, lower slow.
cues.fix: Band rolling? Re-seat it across the shoulder blades.

cues.setup: Band anchored at chest height behind you, staggered stance.
cues.exec: Press both handles forward to full reach, control the return.
cues.fix: Torso twisting? Brace the core, press strictly forward.

cues.setup: Bench at ~30 degrees, grip just outside the shoulders.
cues.exec: Bar to the upper chest, press up and slightly back.
cues.fix: Butt leaving the bench? Lower the incline or the load.

cues.setup: Seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
cues.exec: Press up-and-forward, lower until the chest opens.
cues.fix: Elbows flaring wide? Keep them ~45 degrees from the body.

cues.setup: Seated under the rail, bar at chin height to start.
cues.exec: Press straight up to lockout, lower to the chin.
cues.fix: Neck craning forward? Pull the chin back, bar passes close.

cues.setup: Seat so the handles start at ear height, back flat.
cues.exec: Press overhead without shrugging, lower with control.
cues.fix: Lower back arching? Plant the feet and tuck the ribs.

cues.setup: Backrest near vertical, dumbbells at shoulder height.
cues.exec: Press up until the arms frame the ears, lower to the jaw.
cues.fix: Clanging at the top? Stop just short and keep tension.

cues.setup: Stand on the band, handles at the shoulders, palms forward.
cues.exec: Press overhead to full lockout, resist on the way down.
cues.fix: Leaning back? Squeeze the glutes and ribs down.

cues.setup: Bar end anchored in a corner, other end at the shoulder.
cues.exec: Press up and slightly forward along the bar arc.
cues.fix: Overhead hurts? This diagonal path is the friendly middle.

cues.setup: Dumbbells at the chin, palms facing you to start.
cues.exec: Rotate the palms out as you press to lockout, reverse down.
cues.fix: Rushing the twist? Rotate through the middle third only.

cues.setup: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, slight elbow bend.
cues.exec: Raise one arm to eye level, lower slow, alternate.
cues.fix: Swinging the torso? Lighter weight, glutes tight.

cues.setup: Cable at ankle height, handle in the far hand, lean slightly.
cues.exec: Raise the arm to shoulder height against constant tension.
cues.fix: Shrugging up? Push the shoulder down before each rep.

cues.setup: Upper arms under the pads, elbows bent 90 degrees.
cues.exec: Lift the elbows to shoulder height, lower with control.
cues.fix: Hands leading? Drive with the elbows, hands just rest.

cues.setup: Stand on the band middle, one end in each hand.
cues.exec: Raise both arms to shoulder height, pause, lower slow.
cues.fix: Tension too easy up top? Widen your stance on the band.

cues.setup: Band anchored overhead, elbows pinned to the sides.
cues.exec: Extend to full lockout, squeeze, return with control.
cues.fix: Elbows drifting forward? Pin them and shorten the range.

cues.setup: Single handle at the top pulley, elbow pinned to the side.
cues.exec: Extend fully, one-second squeeze, slow return.
cues.fix: Shoulder creeping up? Step closer to the stack.

cues.setup: On the bench, dumbbells overhead with neutral grip.
cues.exec: Bend only the elbows, lower beside the head, extend up.
cues.fix: Elbows flaring out? Squeeze them toward each other.

cues.setup: Rope at the low pulley, face away, hands behind the head.
cues.exec: Extend overhead to lockout, deep stretch on the return.
cues.fix: Ribs flaring? Small forward lean, core braced.

cues.setup: Seat so the handles sit at mid-chest, slight elbow bend.
cues.exec: Sweep the arms together, squeeze, open until the chest stretches.
cues.fix: Shoulders rolling in? Keep the blades pinned to the pad.

cues.setup: Pulleys at chest height, one step forward, slight lean.
cues.exec: Hug the arms together in an arc, resist the way back.
cues.fix: Turning it into a press? Fix the elbow angle for the set.

cues.setup: Dumbbells over the chest, palms facing, soft elbows.
cues.exec: Open wide until the chest stretches, sweep back together.
cues.fix: Going too deep? Stop where the stretch ends, not the pain.

cues.setup: Straddle the bar, hinge to ~45 degrees, grip the handle.
cues.exec: Pull the handle to the sternum, squeeze the blades, lower slow.
cues.fix: Standing up with the weight? Lock the hinge angle first.

cues.setup: Chest on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging straight down.
cues.exec: Row the elbows past the ribs, squeeze, lower to a stretch.
cues.fix: Chest lifting off? The pad is the lie detector — stay on it.

cues.setup: Chest against the pad, arms long to start.
cues.exec: Drive the elbows back, squeeze the blades, return slow.
cues.fix: Yanking with momentum? Pause one second at the chest.

cues.setup: Sit tall, band around the feet, ends in both hands.
cues.exec: Pull to the belly, elbows close, chest stays proud.
cues.fix: Rounding forward on the return? Hinge only from the hips.

cues.setup: Seated or split stance, single handle at belly height.
cues.exec: Row to the hip without twisting, full stretch forward.
cues.fix: Torso rotating? Brace the obliques, shoulders stay square.

cues.setup: Band anchored overhead, kneel below, arms long.
cues.exec: Pull the elbows to the ribs, squeeze the lats, return slow.
cues.fix: Leaning way back? Stay tall, the lats pull down not back.

cues.setup: Single handle overhead, kneel or sit sideways to the stack.
cues.exec: Pull the elbow to the hip, feel the lat shorten, return long.
cues.fix: Wrist curling? Grip like a hook, the arm is just a rope.

cues.setup: V-handle attached, thighs locked under the pads.
cues.exec: Pull the handle to the upper chest, elbows tight, slow return.
cues.fix: Shoulders shrugging on the stretch? Keep them packed.

cues.setup: Knees on the assist pad, hands just outside the shoulders.
cues.exec: Pull the chin over the bar, lower to a full hang.
cues.fix: Assist too generous? Drop it a plate before adding reps.

edges.note: gleicher Zug, Koerper statt Stange bewegt

cues.setup: Band looped over the bar, one knee or foot in the loop.
cues.exec: Pull the chin over the bar, control the descent fully.
cues.fix: Band does the bottom for you — fight the last inch down.

cues.setup: Face the pad, handles at shoulder height, slight elbow bend.
cues.exec: Sweep the arms back until in line with the shoulders.
cues.fix: Squeezing the blades first? Let the arms lead, not the traps.

cues.setup: Cross the cables at chest height, arms long in front.
cues.exec: Open the arms wide and back, thumbs slightly down.
cues.fix: Elbows bending more each rep? Fix the angle, drop weight.

cues.setup: Band at shoulder height, arms long, shoulder-width grip.
cues.exec: Pull the band to the chest by spreading the arms wide.
cues.fix: Shrugging? Push the shoulders down, lead with the knuckles.

cues.setup: Band anchored at face height, split stance, arms long.
cues.exec: Pull to the face, elbows high, rotate the knuckles back.
cues.fix: Elbows dropping? Pull along eye level, not the chest.

cues.setup: Straight bar at the low pulley, elbows at the sides.
cues.exec: Curl to the chest against constant tension, lower slow.
cues.fix: Elbows drifting up? Pin them and finish lower.

cues.setup: Shoulder-width grip, elbows pinned to the sides.
cues.exec: Curl without swinging, squeeze, lower over two seconds.
cues.fix: Wrists aching? Switch to the EZ bar or widen the grip.

cues.setup: Upper arms flat on the pad, armpits on the top edge.
cues.exec: Curl up, lower until the arms are almost straight.
cues.fix: Bouncing at the bottom? Stop one degree short of lockout.

cues.setup: Neutral grip, dumbbells at the sides, elbows pinned.
cues.exec: Curl thumb-up to the shoulder, alternate arms.
cues.fix: Swinging? Slow the negative and lighten the load.

cues.setup: Bench at ~45 degrees, arms hanging behind the torso.
cues.exec: Curl from the deep stretch, elbows stay behind the ribs.
cues.fix: Elbows swinging forward? Lighter weight, keep the stretch.

cues.setup: Stand on the band, handles in both hands, palms up.
cues.exec: Curl against rising tension, slow three-second lowering.
cues.fix: Too easy at the bottom? Widen the stance for pre-tension.

cues.setup: Overhand grip on the EZ bar, elbows at the sides.
cues.exec: Curl with knuckles up, wrists straight the whole way.
cues.fix: Wrists collapsing? Lighter bar, squeeze the grip hard.

cues.setup: Forearms on the bench, wrists hanging over the edge.
cues.exec: Let the weight roll to the fingers, curl the wrists up.
cues.fix: Forearms lifting? Pin them down, only the wrists move.

cues.setup: Bar in front, shoulder-width grip, arms long.
cues.exec: Shrug straight up toward the ears, pause, lower fully.
cues.fix: Rolling the shoulders? Straight up and down only.

cues.setup: Dumbbells at the sides, palms facing the thighs.
cues.exec: Shrug up, one-second squeeze, stretch fully at the bottom.
cues.fix: Chin poking forward? Keep the neck long and neutral.

cues.setup: Upper back on the bench, one dumbbell held over the chest.
cues.exec: Lower behind the head to a deep stretch, pull back over.
cues.fix: Elbows flaring apart? Keep them narrow like a frame.

cues.setup: Bar at the high pulley, hinge slightly, arms long.
cues.exec: Sweep the bar to the thighs with straight arms, return high.
cues.fix: Turning it into a pushdown? Lock the elbow angle.

cues.setup: Chest on the pad or handles gripped, feet anchored.
cues.exec: Crunch the ribs toward the pelvis, pause, uncurl slowly.
cues.fix: Pulling with the arms? They only rest on the handles.

cues.setup: Feet hooked on the decline bench, hands at the temples.
cues.exec: Curl up vertebra by vertebra, lower under full control.
cues.fix: Yanking the neck? Fingertips touch, never pull.

cues.setup: Cable at chest height, stand sideways, handle at the sternum.
cues.exec: Press straight out and back in — refuse the twist.
cues.fix: Hips rotating? Narrow the stance and lower the weight.

cues.setup: Band anchored at chest height, step out sideways until taut.
cues.exec: Press out, hold two seconds, return without twisting.
cues.fix: Shoulders sneaking up? Long neck, ribs stacked over hips.

cues.setup: Cable high, stand sideways, both hands on the handle.
cues.exec: Chop diagonally across to the far hip, pivot the back foot.
cues.fix: Arms doing the chop? Turn from the trunk, arms stay long.

cues.setup: Hips on the pad edge, ankles locked, arms crossed.
cues.exec: Lower long, rise to a straight line — never hyperextend.
cues.fix: Swinging up? Two seconds up, two seconds down.
